papers.abstract: Large language and vision-language models have substantially advanced robotic behavior planning from natural-language instructions and visual observations. However, safe manipulation in tabletop environments remains challenging because the safety constraints required for a task depend on the surrounding scene and may not be explicitly specified in the instruction. We propose a safety-aware behavior planning framework based on an explicit Constraint Space that stores reusable textual safety rules. Rather than retrieving rules solely by semantic similarity, we formulate constraint selection as task- and environment-conditioned applicability learning. A lightweight query-conditioned dual-tower model identifies the constraints applicable to the current context, which are then provided together with the original task and image to a multimodal behavior planner. To handle incorrect constraint selections and previously unseen hazards, we introduce a multimodal Safety Inspector that evaluates generated primitive plans, reconstructs the complete applicable constraint set, and provides corrective planning feedback. Validated inspection feedback is further used for test-time adaptation of constraint applicability and parameter-efficient adaptation of the Safety Inspector through LoRA, while newly identified constraints are incorporated into the Constraint Space. The resulting framework integrates explicit safety knowledge representation,context-aware constraint selection, corrective safety inspection, and test-time knowledge adaptation for safety-aware robotic behavior planning.

analysis.main_contribution: 提出一个安全感知行为规划框架，包含可复用的显式约束空间、上下文条件约束选择、多模态安全检查器，以及支持测试时约束适用性自适应和LoRA参数高效自适应、新约束识别的知识综合机制。
analysis.method: 基于查询条件的双塔轻量模型进行任务与环境条件下的约束适用性学习；将选定约束连同任务与图像输入多模态行为规划器；引入多模态Safety Inspector对生成的原语计划进行评估、重建完整适用约束集，并提供纠正性规划反馈；通过LoRA进行参数高效自适应并将新约束纳入约束空间。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种基于显式约束空间的安全感知机器人行为规划框架，通过上下文条件约束选择、多模态安全检查器和测试时知识自适应来保证桌面操作安全。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文以视觉-语言模型驱动的机器人行为规划为核心，结合安全约束处理，属于VLA相关研究，但侧重于安全约束表示与自适应，而非动作预测或世界模型。

papers.abstract: Self-supervised Joint Embedding Predictive Architecture (JEPA) models are increasingly used for medical imaging, however there is a limited understanding about robustness of these models toward real-world image changes. We test four JEPA-based chest X-ray encoders, trained on 78,468 NIH ChestX-ray14 images, under six tests: two black-box adversarial attacks (SPSA, Boundary Attack), three image corruptions (Gaussian noise, brightness shift, contrast shift), and a label-scarcity test, measuring embedding change and classification AUROC. These perturbations cause severe, model-dependent damage: encoder-level Cosine Similarity drops as low as 0.33, and AUROC falls by as much as 0.12 in the worst case (I-JEPA under the Boundary Test). We test two ways of training the small predictor on top of each frozen encoder to address this. Adversarial fine-tuning, trained on clean and perturbed images together, raises embedding consistency above 0.97 in nearly every case and improves AUROC, relative to the same perturbed baseline, for most models, with the largest gain of $+0.10$ on I-JEPA. A Vector-Quantized codebook method, trained only on clean images and evaluated on perturbed test images for the first time, instead degrades under distortion for all four models, most noticeably for I-JEPA ($-0.15$ AUROC on average), showing that its discrete bottleneck alone does not provide the robustness that comes from training on perturbed data directly.

analysis.key_results: 对抗微调将嵌入一致性提升至0.97以上，并改善多数模型的AUROC；纯向量量化方法在扰动下性能下降，I-JEPA平均AUROC降低0.15。
analysis.main_contribution: 揭示了JEPA模型在医学影像中的脆弱性，并实证比较了对抗微调与向量量化两种增强鲁棒性的方法。
analysis.method: 在NIH ChestX-ray14上训练四个JEPA编码器，测试黑盒对抗攻击、图像腐蚀和标签稀缺性，并评估对抗微调与向量量化码本方法。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 研究基于JEPA的胸部X光编码器对对抗攻击与图像扰动的鲁棒性，并比较对抗微调与向量量化方法的效果。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文关注医学影像JEPA模型的鲁棒性和量化方法，与VLA（视觉-语言-动作模型）和WAM（世界-动作模型）无直接关系。

papers.abstract: Service robots in domestic and office environments must identify users to provide personalized services based on their preferences and previous interactions. This is challenging because only a few observations may be available for learning, while observation conditions change owing to appearance, environmental noise, and utterance content. To address this challenge, this study proposes a multimodal person concept model that learns person concepts from a small number of observations, without person labels, and enables robust identification under changing conditions. The model employs a nonparametric Bayesian generative model based on the Chinese restaurant process and integrates visual, acoustic, and linguistic features extracted using Contrastive Language-Image Pre-training (CLIP) and Contrastive Language-Audio Pretraining (CLAP), followed by principal component analysis (PCA). We evaluated six participants under eight conditions in which appearance changes, additive noise, and transcription errors were introduced individually and in combination. Averaged over the eight conditions, the proposed model achieved an identification accuracy of 0.89 while inferring the number of person concepts from the observations, which is comparable to k-means clustering that was supplied with the true number of participants (0.88). We also examined PCA dimensionality, modality availability, and variation strength, and demonstrated the model on a Toyota Human Support Robot. These results show that multimodal person concept learning supports robust person identification under changing conditions, and that identification can succeed even when the number of concepts is not correctly recovered. The project page and demonstration video are available at https://okitamisan01.github.io/person_concept/.

analysis.key_results: 在八种条件下对六名参与者的测试中，平均识别准确率为0.89，同时推断出人员概念数量，与已知真实人数的k-means聚类准确率（0.88）相当。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出了一种多模态人员概念模型，该模型利用非参数贝叶斯生成模型（中国餐馆过程）结合CLIP和CLAP特征，无需人员标签即可从少量观测中学习人员概念，并在变化条件下实现鲁棒识别。
analysis.method: 基于中国餐馆过程的非参数贝叶斯生成模型，集成CLIP和CLAP提取的视觉、声学和语言特征，并进行PCA降维。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种多模态人员概念模型，能在少量观测、无标签且观测条件变化的情况下实现鲁棒的人员识别。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文聚焦于服务机器人中的人员识别，属于机器人学习领域，但与本站主题（视觉-语言-动作模型、世界模型等）无直接交集；其多模态学习方法和非参数贝叶斯建模具有一定的参考价值。

papers.abstract: Frontier LLM agents that query databases with tools are among the most accurate text-to-SQL systems, but per-query calls to a hosted model are slow, costly, and expose sensitive organizational queries to external APIs. For example, a Claude Opus 5.5 agent serving 10,000 queries a day costs over $70,000 a year at list price. To what extent can local hardware already owned by an organization offload this burden without compromising the agent's accuracy? We present LuthorSQL, a non-autoregressive 7B text-to-SQL model that serves as a rapid System 1 gate for a slower LLM agent (System 2), escalating queries only when uncertain. LuthorSQL makes a single forward pass to predict slot scores over a bounded grammar for query plans, compiles and runs up to 32 candidate plans, and chooses an answer using a trained validator. On its own, LuthorSQL reaches 68.03% execution accuracy on BIRD's hidden test set at 0.84 s per question on a single GPU, maintains its accuracy in 9 GB with 8-bit quantized weights, and transfers zero-shot to Snowflake, BigQuery, MySQL, PostgreSQL, and DuckDB within 3.1 points of its native SQLite accuracy. Combined with Claude Opus 5.5 in a pre-registered confidence cascade over 227 questions on databases published after Opus's training cutoff, LuthorSQL answers nearly half of all questions locally and cuts API cost by 33.3% at the same accuracy. Finally, contamination probing shows that Opus reproduces 48-92% of public benchmark gold queries verbatim without seeing the schema; however, its tool-assisted accuracy holds on renamed schemas and reaches 95.6-97.4% on post-cutoff databases. Code and data: https://github.com/IAMIbrahimmemon/luthorsql

analysis.key_results: 在BIRD隐藏测试集上执行准确率68.03%，单GPU每题0.84秒；8位量化后9GB内保持准确率；零样本迁移到多种数据库误差在3.1点以内；在227个训练截止后问题上本地回答近半并降低API成本33.3%；Opus在无模式情况下逐字复现48-92%的公开基准黄金查询。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出LuthorSQL，一个非自回归7B文本到SQL模型，作为System 1门控，在保持LLM智能体准确性的同时减少API调用成本。
analysis.method: 单一前向传播预测有界文法上的槽分数，编译并运行最多32个候选计划，并使用训练的验证器选择答案；与Claude Opus 5.5通过预注册置信度级联结合。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: LuthorSQL提出一种非自回归的7B文本到SQL模型，作为快速System 1门控，将不确定性查询升级到慢速LLM智能体以降低API成本。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于文本到SQL的高效推理，与VLA/WAM无直接关系，但其模型量化与推测解码方法对高效推理有参考价值。

papers.abstract: World models that support planning, control, and interpretable reasoning require latent representations that genuinely encode action. Yet the large-scale video data from which such models are learned overwhelmingly lack action annotations. Latent-action models infer action-like variables from observation sequences, enabling action-aware learning from unlabeled videos or trajectories. A fundamental concern, however, remains: a latent that improves future prediction may simply encode the current state, episode progress, task identity, or other predictive shortcuts. Existing evaluation practices---reconstruction loss, rollout fidelity, action recovery, or downstream performance---cannot isolate this distinction. We introduce the Latent Action Support Ratio (LASR), a dimensionless metric that measures, under offline evaluation on held-out data, whether a learned latent provides predictive support for action-related targets beyond the current state and non-action alternatives. LASR provides two complementary summaries: GeoLASR captures typical support, while WorstLASR identifies the weakest case. We instantiate the LASR benchmark with recorded actions and corresponding physical state changes as targets, episode-held-out splits, one predictor type for all comparisons, and positive and negative controls. Experiments on recorded robot manipulation data and a matched multi-task panel demonstrate that LASR detects known action information, rejects representative non-action shortcuts, and enables graded comparisons among imperfect latent representations. We further use LASR to train and audit a lightweight residual adapter, obtaining descriptively better point estimates whose uncertainty is assessed with paired comparisons. LASR thus provides a principled offline protocol for measuring action-related predictive support in world-model latents.

analysis.key_results: 在机器人操作数据和匹配的多任务面板上，LASR能够检测已知动作信息、拒绝非动作捷径，并对不完美的潜变量表示进行分级比较。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入LASR度量，可在离线评估中区分潜变量是否编码了动作信息，而非仅编码状态或非动作捷径。
analysis.method: 通过GeoLASR和WorstLASR两个互补摘要，在保留回合数据上评估潜变量对动作相关目标的预测支持，并使用正负控制进行验证。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出Latent Action Support Ratio (LASR)度量，用于评估世界模型潜变量对动作相关目标的预测支持程度。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对世界模型中动作基础潜变量的评估问题，与WAM的核心关注点高度相关，提供了可操作性的评估协议，有助于筛选和改进用于动作预测和规划的世界模型潜在表示。

figures.caption: Two shortcuts in offline latent-action evaluation. (a) A trajectory from the ALOHA static-battery release illustrates how the current state and task phase constrain the next motion [ 51 ] . (b) DROID-100 observations from distinct scenes, viewpoints, and object layouts illustrate how scene and episode identity may help predict typical transitions without isolating action-specific information [ 24 ] .

figures.caption: Overview of LASR. (A) A logged transition aligns the current state S t S_{t} , recorded action A t A_{t} , and next state S t + 1 S_{t+1} . (B) For each target–fold pair, separately fitted state, latent, and validation-selected control routes yield held-out risks E state E_{\mathrm{state}} , E Z E_{Z} , and E ctrl E_{\mathrm{ctrl}} . (C) LASR divides E Z E_{Z} by the smaller of the two reference risks. A score below one means that the latent route outperforms both references; GeoLASR and WorstLASR are the geometric mean and maximum across target–fold scores, respectively. Lower is better.

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models bring multimodal understanding and world knowledge to end-to-end autonomous driving. To further improve the quality of predicted trajectories, existing studies introduce candidate refinement, residual denoising, and token correction. However, these methods typically focus on unified refinement of the entire trajectory, paying limited attention to the distinct physical quantities and their interactions. We further investigate physical specialization and coordination in trajectory refinement, centering on position and heading for simpler and more intuitive correction modeling. To this end, we propose CARE-Drive (Coupled Alternating Refinement for Ego-trajectories), which decomposes trajectory refinement into waypoint residual correction and position-conditioned heading generation. Through imitation learning and a future-token auxiliary task, the backbone provides predictive representations and a base trajectory. The position expert predicts bounded metric waypoint residuals, while the heading expert reconstructs vehicle orientation from adjacent angular increments conditioned on the corrected path. With the backbone frozen, the two experts are optimized alternately through supervised initialization and reinforcement fine-tuning. This design simplifies refinement through clear physical specialization while preserving conditional coupling during prediction and optimization. On NAVSIM v1, CARE-Drive achieves 88.8 PDMS, improving by 2.4 points over the unrefined base trajectories generated by the same backbone. Ablation studies further support the effectiveness of specialized experts and staged training.

analysis.key_results: 在NAVSIM v1上达到88.8 PDMS，比相同骨干网络生成的未细化轨迹提高2.4分。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出CARE-Drive框架，将轨迹细化分解为位置和航向的物理专业化处理，并通过耦合交替优化实现高精度轨迹预测。
analysis.method: 将轨迹细化分解为航点残差校正和位置条件航向生成，位置专家预测有界度量航点残差，航向专家根据修正路径从相邻角度增量重建车辆方向，两个专家交替优化（监督初始化+强化微调）且骨干网络冻结。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出CARE-Drive，将VLA模型的自车轨迹细化分解为航点残差校正和位置条件航向生成，通过交替优化实现物理专业化与协调。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该工作直接针对视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型在端到端自动驾驶中的轨迹预测质量提升，通过专业化细化模块改进动作生成，与VLA主题高度相关。

(a) The predictive backbone produces shared action features and an initial trajectory; a frozen video teacher provides future-feature supervision during training. (b) The position expert predicts metric waypoint residuals, and the heading expert reconstructs orientation from adjacent angular increments conditioned on corrected positions and shared action features. Greedy decoding yields one eight-waypoint trajectory. (c) Dynamically weighted imitation learning trains the backbone, followed by alternating position and heading optimization with the backbone frozen. Each expert update holds its conditioning models fixed. Snowflakes mark frozen modules.

papers.abstract: We present GigaEdge Spench, an open-source SDK for streaming speech enhancement on CPU servers, mobile devices, and in browsers. Applications can build enhancement channels from neural denoising, normalization and dynamics blocks, sample-rate conversion, and acoustic echo cancellation where supported. These stages can be combined, while normalization can also run without a neural model. The release includes an 8 kHz INT8 denoiser and discriminative and hybrid 48 kHz FP32 models. A shared C++ core supports ONNX Runtime and TensorFlow Lite through native interfaces, Android and iOS SDKs, and WebAssembly integration. Independent stream contexts share model resources, and consecutive frames from one stream can be processed in a single inference call. We evaluate the released models on EARS-WHAM v2 and compare their quality and processing costs with RNNoise and DPDFNet2. All tested native and Web configurations process files faster than real time, although larger chunks require more time to collect input. We also measure how many streams a shared model can process on a CPU. Our contribution is a configurable deployment system and an experimental study of how model choice, chunk size, and execution environment affect its use. All reported SDK timing uses ONNX Runtime. Index Terms: speech enhancement, streaming inference, cross-platform deployment, temporal frame grouping, computational efficiency

analysis.key_results: 所有测试的原生和Web配置处理文件均快于实时；较大块需要更多输入收集时间；测量了共享模型在CPU上的多流处理能力；SDK计时使用ONNX Runtime。
analysis.main_contribution: 提供了一个可配置的部署系统，并实验研究了模型选择、块大小和执行环境对使用的影响。
analysis.method: 基于ONNX Runtime和TensorFlow Lite的共享C++核心，支持INT8量化模型和FP32模型，结合多阶段处理、流上下文模型共享等。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 论文介绍了一个用于在CPU、移动设备和浏览器上部署流式语音增强模型的开源SDK，并研究了模型量化、块大小和执行环境对性能的影响。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文不涉及VLA或WAM，但作为模型量化和高效推理的独立研究，其方法和部署经验可能对在机器人平台上高效部署VLA/WAM模型具有参考价值。

papers.title: GigaEdge Spench: An SDK for Practical Streaming Speech Enhancement

papers.abstract: Quantizing zero-shot industrial anomaly detectors for edge neural processing units can degrade defect detection and localization. We present EdgeZSAD (Edge Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection), a deployment framework whose methodological contribution is Value-Range Quantization (VRQ). We diagnose how attention Value tensors inherit overly wide ranges from fused query-key-value projections and assign independent ranges calibrated on source data, without retraining or changing quantized weights. The engineering application is native deployment of a foundation-model detector for industrial inspection, evaluated on three public benchmarks and Qualcomm edge devices. Under minimum-maximum and mean-squared-error calibration, VRQ improves image-level discrimination and per-region overlap. In the primary calibration set, it recovers 90-98% of the loss in combined image and pixel discrimination relative to half precision, with a small increase in latency over baseline quantization. Matched tensor overrides reproduce the recovery without adding graph nodes, identifying independent Value-range assignment as the effective intervention in the evaluated runtime family.

analysis.key_results: VRQ 在三个公共基准和 Qualcomm 边缘设备上提升图像级判别和区域重叠；在主要校准设置下，相对于半精度恢复 90-98% 的图像和像素判别损失，延迟较基线量化仅小幅增加；匹配的张量覆盖无需添加图节点即可重现恢复效果。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出 EdgeZSAD 部署框架及其方法论贡献值域量化（VRQ），通过为注意力 Value 张量独立分配量化范围来改善量化后的零样本工业异常检测性能。
analysis.method: 诊断注意力 Value 张量因融合 QKV 投影而继承过宽范围，并在源数据上独立校准 Value 张量的量化范围，不重新训练也不改变量化权重；使用最小-最大和均方误差校准。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出 EdgeZSAD 框架与值域量化方法，通过独立校准注意力 Value 张量的量化范围，缓解零样本异常检测模型在边缘NPU上量化部署导致的性能下降。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注模型量化在零样本异常检测上的边缘部署，不涉及 VLA、WAM 或机器人世界模型，但对本站量化与高效推理主题具有直接的方法参考价值。

papers.abstract: The rapid evolution of Embodied AI has enabled Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models to excel in multimodal perception and task execution. However, applying Reinforcement Learning (RL) to these massive models in large-scale distributed environments faces severe systemic bottlenecks, primarily due to the resource conflict between high-fidelity physical simulation and the intensive VRAM/bandwidth demands of deep learning. This conflict often leaves overall throughput constrained by execution-phase inefficiencies. To address these challenges, we propose D-VLA, a high-concurrency, low-latency distributed RL framework for large-scale embodied foundation models. D-VLA introduces "Plane Decoupling," physically isolating high-frequency training data from low-frequency weight control to eliminate interference between simulation and optimization. We further design a four-thread asynchronous "Swimlane" pipeline, enabling full parallel overlap of sampling, inference, gradient computation, and parameter distribution. Additionally, a dual-pool VRAM management model and topology-aware replication resolve memory fragmentation and optimize communication efficiency. Experiments on benchmarks like LIBERO show that D-VLA significantly outperforms mainstream RL frameworks in throughput and sampling efficiency for billion-parameter VLA models. In trillion-parameter scalability tests, our framework maintains exceptional stability and linear speedup, providing a robust system for high-performance general-purpose embodied agents.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO基准上，D-VLA在吞吐量和采样效率方面显著优于主流RL框架；在万亿参数扩展测试中保持稳定和线性加速。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出D-VLA框架，通过平面解耦、四线程异步Swimlane流水线、双池VRAM管理及拓扑感知复制，解决大规模分布式RL中仿真与深度学习资源冲突，提升VLA模型训练效率。
analysis.method: 平面解耦物理隔离高频训练数据与低频权重控制；四线程异步流水线并行采样、推理、梯度计算和参数分发；双池VRAM管理与拓扑感知复制。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出分布式强化学习框架D-VLA，通过解耦仿真与优化、四线程流水线及内存管理等技术，提升亿级参数VLA模型的训练吞吐和采样效率。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文聚焦于VLA模型的分布式强化学习训练系统，属于VLA主题的关键基础设施，直接服务于高效训练大规模具身模型。

papers.abstract: Speculative decoding accelerates LLM inference but suffers from performance degradation when target models are fine-tuned for specific domains. A naive solution is to retrain draft models for every target model, which is costly and inefficient. To address this, we introduce a practical parameter- and data-efficient framework named Efficient Draft Adaptation, abbreviated as EDA, for efficiently adapting draft models. EDA introduces three innovations: (1) a decoupled architecture that utilizes shared and private components to model the shared and target-specific output distributions separately, enabling parameter-efficient adaptation by updating only the lightweight private component; (2) a data regeneration strategy that utilizes the fine-tuned target model to regenerate training data, thereby improving the alignment between training and speculative decoding, leading to higher average acceptance length; (3) a sample selection mechanism that prioritizes high-value data for efficient adaptation. Our experiments show that EDA effectively restores speculative performance on fine-tuned models, achieving superior average acceptance lengths with significantly reduced training costs compared to full retraining. Code is available at https://github.com/Lyn-Lucy/Efficient-Draft-Adaptation.

analysis.key_results: 实验表明EDA能有效恢复微调模型上的投机解码性能，在显著降低训练成本的同时实现更高的平均接受长度。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出Efficient Draft Adaptation (EDA)框架，利用解耦架构、数据再生策略和样本选择机制，以较低成本适配草稿模型，恢复微调模型上的投机解码性能。
analysis.method: 解耦架构（共享与私有组件）、数据再生策略（利用微调目标模型重新生成训练数据）、样本选择机制。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出一种参数和数据高效的草稿模型适配框架EDA，用于恢复微调后目标模型上的投机解码性能。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 本文专注于大语言模型推理加速，未涉及视觉-语言-动作模型（VLA）或世界-动作模型（WAM），但其参数与数据高效适配草稿模型的方法对利用投机解码加速机器人模型推理具有潜在参考价值。

papers.abstract: Vision-language-action models must enable agents to execute long-horizon tasks under partial observability. However, most existing approaches remain observation-driven, relying on short context windows or repeated queries to vision-language models (VLMs). This leads to loss of task progress, action repetition under perceptual aliasing, and high inference latency. While semantic grounding is important, long-horizon manipulation fundamentally requires persistent, action-conditioned state representations. Current VLAs lack such representations and exhibit limited temporal and physical reasoning, making them ill-suited for multi-stage control. This paper introduces RB-VLA, a belief-centric architecture trained with self-supervised world-model objectives that maintains a compact latent state encoding task-relevant history, dynamics, and object interactions. Queried once per task, the VLM provides high-level intent, while the belief tracks task progress and enables phase-aware, causally grounded control under partial observability without storing raw observations or scaling memory with time. The belief and intent jointly condition a diffusion policy for robust closed-loop execution. RB-VLA outperforms prior VLAs on long-horizon benchmarks, achieving 52.5 percent and 37.5 percent higher success rates on multi-stage pick-and-place and stacking tasks, respectively, compared to pi_0. It also reduces inference latency by up to five times relative to baselines and eliminates memory growth across timesteps observed in existing VLAs. Ablations show the belief module is the primary driver of performance, increasing success rates from 32.5 percent without belief to 77.5 percent with belief.

analysis.key_results: 在长时程基准上优于先前VLA，多阶段拾取放置和堆叠任务成功率分别比pi_0高52.5%和37.5%；推理延迟较基线降低最多5倍；消除现有VLA中随时间的记忆增长；消融显示信念模块使成功率从32.5%提升至77.5%。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出RB-VLA，一种信念中心的VLA架构，通过自监督世界模型目标训练紧凑隐状态，实现动作条件的状态表示和长时程任务的高效闭环执行。
analysis.method: 信念中心架构结合自监督世界模型目标；VLM每任务仅查询一次提供高层意图；信念跟踪任务进展并实现相位感知、因果接地控制；信念与意图联合条件扩散策略执行动作。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: RB-VLA引入信念中心架构与自监督世界模型目标，在部分可观测条件下实现长时程机器人操作的高效闭环控制。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 论文直接聚焦VLA，并引入世界模型目标训练信念状态，将动作条件状态表示与长时程操作结合，对VLA与WAM的交叉研究具有核心参考价值。

papers.abstract: Spatial intelligence is central to embodied cognition, yet contemporary AI systems still struggle to reason about physical interactions in open-world human environments. Despite strong performance on controlled benchmarks, vision-language models often fail to jointly model physical dynamics, reference frames, and the latent human intentions that drive spatial change. We introduce Teleo-Spatial Intelligence (TSI), which captures an important aspect of spatial reasoning: integrating physical dynamics and action goals to reason about actions and their spatial consequences. To evaluate TSI, we present EscherVerse, a large-scale open-world resource built from 11,328 real-world videos, including an 8,000-example benchmark and a 35,963-example instruction-tuning set. Across 27 state-of-the-art vision-language models and an independent analysis of first-pass human responses from 11 annotators, we identify a persistent teleo-spatial reasoning gap: the strongest proprietary model achieves 57.26% overall accuracy, far below first-pass human performance, which ranges from 84.81% to 95.14% with a mean of 90.62%. Fine-tuning on real-world, intent-aware data narrows this gap for open-weight models, but does not close it. EscherVerse provides a diagnostic testbed for purpose-aware spatial reasoning and highlights a critical gap between pattern recognition and human-level understanding in embodied AI.

analysis.key_results: 最强的专有模型总体准确率为57.26%，远低于人类首次响应表现（84.81%至95.14%，平均90.62%）；在真实世界意图感知数据上微调可缩小开放权重模型的差距，但未能完全消除。
analysis.main_contribution: 提出遥测空间智能(TSI)概念，并构建开放世界大规模基准EscherVerse，系统评估视觉语言模型在物理动力学和意图推理上的表现，揭示其与人类水平的差距。
analysis.method: 构建包含11,328个真实世界视频的EscherVerse资源，其中8,000个用于基准测试，35,963个用于指令微调；在27个视觉语言模型上进行评估，并与11名标注者的首次人类响应进行比较。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 本文提出遥测空间智能(TSI)概念并发布EscherVerse基准，评估视觉语言模型在物理动力学和意图驱动空间推理上的能力，发现其与人类表现存在显著差距。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该基准聚焦物理动力学与意图推理，对具身智能和机器人世界模型具有一定相关性，但未直接涉及视觉语言动作模型或世界行为模型的训练与推理。

papers.abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models offer a unified framework for robotic manipulation by integrating visual perception, language understanding, and control generation. However, existing VLA systems still struggle to generalize across diverse tasks, scenes, and camera viewpoints, and often produce coarse or unstable actions. We argue that these limitations are closely tied to the structural properties of actions in VLA settings, including the inherent multi-peaked nature of action distributions, the token-based symbolic reasoning of pretrained VLM/VLA backbones, and the effective finite resolution imposed by real-world robotic control. Motivated by these properties, we introduce E0, a tweedie discrete diffusion framework that formulates action generation as iterative denoising over quantized action tokens. By operating in a discrete action space with a principled diffusion process, E0 naturally aligns with token-based reasoning, supports fine-grained yet executable action control, and avoids the distributional mismatch of masking-based discrete diffusion. Experiments on LIBERO, VLABench, ManiSkill, and a real-world Franka arm demonstrate that E0 achieves state-of-the-art performance across diverse environments, outperforming strong baselines by 8.1% on average.

analysis.key_results: 在LIBERO、VLABench、ManiSkill和真实Franka手臂上的实验表明，E0在不同环境中实现了最先进的性能，平均超过强基线8.1%。
analysis.main_contribution: 引入E0，一种tweedie离散扩散框架，将动作生成形式化为量化动作令牌上的迭代去噪，从而与基于令牌的推理自然对齐，支持细粒度且可执行的动作控制，并避免了基于掩码的离散扩散的分布不匹配。
analysis.method: 使用Tweedie离散扩散在离散动作空间中进行迭代去噪，动作表示为量化动作令牌。
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 提出E0，一种基于Tweedie离散扩散的VLA模型动作生成框架，通过量化动作令牌上的迭代去噪实现细粒度且可执行的动作控制。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 该论文直接针对VLA模型的动作生成，通过离散扩散机制提高动作预测的表达性和细粒度控制，核心贡献在于VLA策略学习。动作空间量化与去噪过程涉及动作世界的建模，与WAM有方法上的关联。

papers.abstract: The rapid emergence of foundation models, particularly large language models and vision-language models, has introduced a transformative paradigm in robotics. The models offer powerful capabilities in semantic understanding, high-level reasoning, and cross-modal generalization, enabling significant advances in perception, planning, control, and human-robot interaction. This critical review provides a structured synthesis of recent developments and organizes applications into four directions: simulation-driven robotics, open-world operation, sim-to-real transfer, and adaptable robotic systems. Unlike existing surveys that emphasize isolated capabilities, this work highlights integrated, system-level strategies and evaluates their practical feasibility in real-world environments. Key enabling trends such as procedural scene generation, policy generalization, and multimodal reasoning are discussed alongside core bottlenecks, including limited embodiment, lack of multimodal data, safety risks, and computational constraints. Through this lens, this paper identifies both the architectural strengths and critical limitations of foundation model-based robotics, highlighting open challenges in real-time operation, grounding, resilience, and trust. The review concludes with a roadmap of proposed future research directions for bridging semantic reasoning and physical intelligence through more robust, interpretable, and embodied models.

analysis.limitations: 指出现有局限包括：有限具身、缺乏多模态数据、安全风险、计算约束，以及实时运行、接地、弹性和信任等开放性挑战。
analysis.main_contribution: 对基础模型驱动机器人的最新进展进行结构化综合，强调系统级集成策略与真实环境可行性评估，并提出未来研究路线图。
analysis.method: 文献综述与批判性分析
analysis.one_sentence_summary: 综述基础模型在机器人领域的应用，涵盖模拟、开放世界、sim-to-real和可适应系统，指出瓶颈与未来方向。
analysis.relation_to_vla_wam: 与VLA主题相关，综述了视觉语言模型在机器人中的应用，但不涉及世界模型或量化/推测解码。
